title: Northloop Payments Payout Plan Changes and Bank Account Changes
content:
## Plan changes

A seller may move to a Northloop Payments payout plan only when the profile age, the seller's current performance standing level and the trailing 12-month sale credits meet that plan's minimum account age, eligible standing levels and minimum trailing sales. At each plan review an account that no longer qualifies for its plan is moved to the plan's standing fallback plan. A plan change takes effect from the next payout cycle.

The trailing 12-month sale credits are the sale credits booked on the account over a rolling window of 365 calendar days ending on the handling date, that day included.

| Requirement of the plan sought | Compared with |
|---|---|
| minimum account age | the age of the seller profile |
| eligible standing levels | the seller's current performance standing level |
| minimum trailing sales | the trailing 12-month sale credits |

All three must be met. A plan review that finds the account no longer qualifying moves it to its plan's standing fallback plan; any change takes effect from the next payout cycle.

## Bank account changes

A new bank account must be verified before it is used, and the bank change payout hold then runs from its verification date.

*Hypothetical reading.* A seller at Top Rated Level with a profile 400 days old and trailing 12-month sale credits of 30000.00 USD meets the Payments Daily Plus requirements (365 days; Top Rated Level eligible; 25000.00 USD); with 20000.00 USD of trailing sale credits the same seller would not.
